title: Voting of 'Estrelas da Casa' mobilizes audience and determines favorites
seoTitle: Voting of 'Estrelas da Casa' mobilizes audience and.
subtitle: The audience holds the decision in its hands for the Pop and Pagode categories, with one participant already known in the national artistic scene.
excerpt: The show 'Estrelas da Casa' is in the spotlight with a decisive vote underway, which will determine the favorites in the Pop and Pagode categories.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The program “Estrelas da Casa” is shaking up the Brazilian music scene with a decisive vote in progress, putting the public at the center of choosing the next talents. The audience has until this Thursday (3), during the live broadcast, to elect its favorites in the Pop and Pagode categories, directly influencing the singers' stay in the competition.

The vote that decides the artists' future

The “Estrelas da Casa” format makes viewers the decisive factor. Public votes point to the preferred participants in each musical category, Pop and Pagode, and thereby influence the singers' continuation in the show. The program airs on Globo, and the voting ends this Thursday (3) live during the transmission.

The public's power in the final decision

The tally of popular votes is concentrated at the moment of the live broadcast, culminating in a result that will apply to the next stage of the competition. The audience is responsible for indicating its preference for the singers who impressed most during the performances, determining who stays on stage.

Bruno Gadiol: a name already known on stage and screen

Among the participants, 28‑year‑old Bruno Gadiol is the last member of the pop group to be selected for “Estrelas da Casa” and already has an audience that follows him. Born in São Paulo (SP), the singer and actor currently lives in Goiânia (GO), where he also performs at a jazz club. His artistic career began to attract attention in his teenage years.

Bruno Gadiol's multifaceted career

Bruno started singing in childhood, inspired by musical films. In 2013, he took part in a music contest on “TV Xuxa,” winning alongside three other contestants. Three years later, in 2016, he joined the cast of “The Voice Brasil,” finishing the competition in fifth place. In music, he released the albums “Jovem” and “Gêmeos em gêmeos,” the latter featuring the singer completely naked on the cover.

As an actor, Bruno Gadiol has built a trajectory with roles in “Malhação – Viva a diferença” (2017/18) and “As Five” (2020/24). This year, he also attracted attention in theater by playing a male escort who experiences a psychological clash in the play “Quarto 2107: A noite em que o segredo bateu à porta,” written by journalist Arthur Pires. The actor appeared naked on the promotional poster for the drama.

Other projects and the artist's personal life

Currently, Bruno Gadiol maintains an open relationship with plastic surgeon Diogo Höhl. His artistic versatility, moving between music and acting, makes him one of the names to watch closely in the current edition of “Estrelas da Casa,” where public votes are crucial for his stay in the competition.
